mechanism: Phenelzine inhibits MAO and can increase serotonergic activity; clopidogrel may potentiate bleeding risk through platelet inhibition while phenelzine affects hemostasis and increases hypertensive/serotonergic complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with careful monitoring and dose adjustment; consider alternative antidepressant with lower serotonergic interaction potential if antiplatelet therapy is essential.
